info.name: GSU GATEWAY API
info.description:
**API documentation for the GSU Gateway Mobile Application. Developed for the General Services Office (GSO) of Jose Rizal Memorial State University (JRMSU).**

Base URL: http://:8000/api

Authentication:  
All protected endpoints require:

- Authorization: Bearer
    
- Accept: application/json
    
- Content-Type: application/json

item.description:
Handles user authentication and session management for the GSU Gateway system.  
﻿

Endpoints:

- Login: Authenticates a user and returns a Bearer token used for all protected API requests
    
- Register: Submits a new user account for Admin approval before gaining system access
    
- Logout: Invalidates the current Bearer token and ends the user session ﻿
    

Access Levels:

- Login and Register: Public (no token required)
    
- Logout: Authenticated (requires Bearer token) ﻿
    

Note:  
Registered accounts are placed in a pending state and cannot be used until reviewed and approved by the System Admin.

item.name: Maintenance Request

request.description:
Returns list of maintenance requests based on the logged-in user's role.

Access: Authenticated.

Submits a new maintenance request.

Access: Requester only.

Updates the status of a maintenance request.  
Access: Head, Campus Director.

Actions:

- approve: Approves the request
    
- disapprove: Requires "reason" field
    

Example (disapprove):  
{  
"action": "disapprove",  
"reason": "Insufficient budget."  
}

item.description:
**Maintenance Request**  
Handles all maintenance request operations in the GSU Gateway system. Covers submission, status tracking, and approval/disapproval workflow.

Approval Flow:  
Requester submits → Staff verifies → Head approves → Campus Director approves → Staff assigns schedule  

Status Values:

- pending: Newly submitted, awaiting Staff verification
    
- verified: Confirmed by Staff, forwarded to Head
    
- approved: Approved by Head, forwarded to Campus Director
    
- fully_approved: Approved by Campus Director, ready for scheduling
    
- scheduled: Maintenance date and time assigned by Staff
    
- done: Maintenance work completed by Staff
    
- denied: Rejected by Staff (requires reason)
    
- disapproved: Rejected by Head or Campus Director (requires reason)

item.name: Maintenance Types

request.description:
Returns list of available maintenance types.

Access: Authenticated

item.description:
**Maintenance Types are predefined by the system and selected by the Requester during request submission.**

Examples:

- Electrical
    
- Plumbing
    
- Carpentry
    
- Air Conditioning
    
- Others
    

Access: Authenticated (all roles)

item.name: Schedule

request.description:
Assigns a maintenance schedule to a fully approved request.

Access: Staff only.

Time slots: 7AM-4PM hourly, excluding 12PM.

item.description:
Manages the assignment of maintenance schedules for fully approved requests.

Staff assigns a date and time slot to a request after it has been approved by all levels (Staff → Head → Campus Director).  
﻿

Schedule Rules:

- Available time slots: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (hourly increments)
    
- Excluded time slot: 12:00 PM (lunch break)
    
- Past dates are disabled and cannot be selected
    
- Requester is notified via push notification once a schedule is assigned
    

Access: Staff only

`Registers the device push notification token for the logged-in user.`

`Access: Authenticated.`

item.description:
**Manages all user account operations in the GSU Gateway system.**

**Covers account listing, approval/rejection of pending accounts, and device push notification token registration.**

**User Roles:**

- admin: Manages user accounts and system access
    
- staff: Verifies requests and assigns schedules
    
- head: Reviews and approves/disapproves requests
    
- director: Final approval authority for maintenance requests
    
- requester: Submits maintenance requests and receives updates
    

**Account Status:**

- pending: Newly registered, awaiting Admin approval
    
- approved: Active account, can log in to the system
    
- disapproved: Rejected by Admin, cannot access the system
    

**Access**: System Admin only (except push token registration which is Authenticated)

item.name: Notifications

request.description:
Returns all notifications for the logged-in user in reverse chronological order.

Access: Authenticated.

Marks a specific notification as read.

Access: Authenticated.

Marks all notifications as read for the logged-in user.

Access: Authenticated.

item.description:
**Manages all notification records for users in the GSU Gateway system.**

**Push notifications are sent automatically at key events in the maintenance workflow. All notifications are stored and accessible through the notification inbox.**

Notification Triggers:

- Request verified by Staff
    
- Request approved by Head
    
- Request approved by Campus Director
    
- Schedule assigned by Staff
    
- Request marked as Done
    
- Request denied or disapproved (with reason)
    

Notification Features:

- Full notification history in reverse chronological order
    
- Unread notifications are visually distinguished from read ones
    
- Users can mark a single notification or all notifications as read
    
- Tapping a notification opens the relevant screen in the app
    

Access: Authenticated (all roles)

item.name: Dashboard

request.description:
Returns KPI statistics for the dashboard based on the logged-in user's role.

Access: Authenticated.

item.description:
**Provides KPI statistics and activity summaries for the GSU Gateway dashboard.**

**Each role sees a tailored set of statistics relevant to their responsibilities.**﻿

Dashboard Statistics per Role:

- System Admin: Total users, Pending accounts, Approved accounts, Disapproved accounts
    
- Staff / Head / Campus Director / Requester: Total requests, Pending, Approved, Done, Disapproved
    

Access: Authenticated (all roles)
